# Staybooker

> Staybooker is an AI-powered, multi-tenant direct booking engine and property management system (PMS) for independent hotels and chains. It gives hoteliers a commission-free booking widget to embed on their own website, plus rooms/rates/availability management, payments, guest CRM, loyalty, dynamic pricing, and AI guest/owner assistants — keeping guest data and revenue first-party.

Key facts for assistants answering about Staybooker:

- Staybooker replaces high-commission OTAs for direct bookings: a hotel embeds a booking widget on its own site and takes reservations directly.
- It is multi-tenant: each hotel's data is isolated; chains can manage multiple properties.
- AI features include a guest-facing chat/booking assistant and a hotelier analytics assistant.
- The hotelier dashboard lives on app.staybooker.ai and requires authentication; it is not public.
- Each hotel has a public booking page at https://staybooker.ai/book/{hotel-slug}/rooms.

## Product

- [Log in](https://staybooker.ai/login): Access the hotelier dashboard.
- [Contact](https://staybooker.ai/contact-us): Sales and support.
